title: Cooperating against Catastrophe
abstract: arXiv:2609.28291v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study a continuous-time game in which two firms choose how quickly to advance their capabilities while an exogenous safety threshold advances at a fixed rate. When the capability frontier (max of firms' capabilities) exceeds the safety threshold, all firms are exposed to common disaster that arrives at a hazard rate increasing in the capability-safety difference. We characterize Markov perfect equilibria in terms of the disaster risk, how quickly safety advances, and flow payoffs: when they are low, only racing is an equilibrium; when they are intermediate, racing and pacing coexist; when they are high, only pacing survives. Across all subgame perfect equilibria, low risk induces perpetual racing while high risk rules it out and we bound the probability of disaster across all SPE. translated_abstract: 我们研究一个连续时间博弈，其中两家企业各自选择推进自身能力的速度，而一个外生的安全阈值以固定速率推进。当能力前沿（各企业能力的最大值）超过安全阈值时，所有企业都将暴露于共同灾难之中，该灾难到来的风险率随能力与安全之间差距的增大而上升。我们用灾难风险、安全推进速度以及流量收益来刻画马尔可夫完美均衡：当流量收益较低时，只有“竞速”是均衡；当收益处于中等水平时，“竞速”与“节奏控制”共存；当收益较高时，只有“节奏控制”能够存续。在所有子博弈完美均衡中，低风险会导致永久的竞速，而高风险则会排除竞速，我们还给出了所有子博弈完美均衡下灾难概率的界。如果内部能力在部署之前以固定时滞被隐藏，则更难维持节奏控制，这凸显了透明度的重要性……
tldr: 该论文构建了一个连续时间博弈模型，研究两家企业在能力赶超安全阈值引发共同灾难风险时的策略选择，证明均衡结果由收益水平与灾难风险决定——低收益下只有竞速均衡、中等收益下竞速与节奏控制共存、高收益下仅存节奏控制——并揭示了能力信息透明对维持克制发展的关键作用。
en_tdlr: This paper models a continuous-time game where two firms advance capabilities against a rising safety threshold under shared catastrophe risk, showing that equilibria range from pure racing to pure pacing depending on payoffs and disaster risk, and that transparency about hidden capabilities is crucial for sustaining restraint.
